name: KAST Dollar
oneLiner: USDK is KAST's 1:1 extension of M0's M token on Solana; it inherits M's upstream collateral and governance while KAST retains the underlying yield.
collateral: M0 M held through the USDK extension relationship. USDK-specific sources do not publish the current upstream M issuer allocation, collateral composition, or custody split; those risks are inherited from M. KAST retains the underlying yield rather than passing it to USDK holders.
pegMechanism: 1:1 wrapper around M (M0) on Solana — KAST mints USDK by depositing/wrapping M into the USDK SPL Token-2022 mint, and unwraps back to M for redemption; user-facing fiat on/off-ramp and redemption are mediated by the KAST app via licensed partners (Tazapay, BitGo, Fireblocks). The Token-2022 mint has transfer hooks and confidential-transfer extensions with authority held by KAST

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDK is KAST's branded USD-pegged payment token for consumer payments and savings, built on M0 programmable stablecoin infrastructure on Solana.

genius.notes: KAST Tech is incorporated in Anjouan, Comoros (Reg No. 16223) and explicitly states it is not a bank; licensed services are provided by third-party partners (BitGo, Fireblocks, Tazapay). In September 2025, KAST's founder stated an aspiration to 'upgrade USDK to be issued in the US by an issuer that meets the Genius standard' and referenced ongoing discussions with major issuers — but this remains an informal forward-looking intent, not a formal application. As of 2026-06-18, no PPSI approval or foreign-issuer exception has been filed or granted for USDK under the GENIUS Act. The GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no final rules issued and no issuer having received a PPSI approval.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered foreign-issuer exception under the GENIUS Act has been publicly filed or granted for USDK or its issuer KAST Tech. The KAST founder's September 2025 statement of intent to partner with a US-compliant issuer has not translated into any publicly visible application or structural change as of June 2026. No US federal or state regulator has published any filing, acknowledgment, or action regarding KAST or USDK.

mintAuthority.summary: USDK is an M0-backed Solana extension; base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway, Solana movement relies on M0 portal infrastructure, and live Solana Token-2022 metadata exposes a USDK mint authority.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDK depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 Solana Portal
controls.capDescription: M0 documents Solana as a spoke deployment bridged from Ethereum; official Solana docs did not expose a USDK-specific mint-authority address.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: USDK is a Solana extension of M0 M; base M supply remains governed by the Ethereum MinterGateway.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: M0 Solana Portal program is confirmed executable, but token-specific remote-peer config was not independently enumerated.
routeChecks.caps: Effective Solana extension capacity is bounded by the portal route and base M supply, not by an immutable Solana token cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Solana program upgrade authority is 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW where checked.

controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432836017, Portal program mzp1q2j5Hr1QuLC3KFBCAUz5aUckT6qyuZKZ3WJnMmY was executable under BPFLoaderUpgradeable; its ProgramData upgrade authority was 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW. controls.label: USDK Token-2022 mint authority (PDA)

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: USDK mint authority is an off-curve PDA derived from the M0 extension program with seeds=["mint_authority"].
routeChecks.caps: No immutable token-level mint cap was observed; effective capacity depends on the extension program, portal route, and underlying M supply.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Extension program upgrade authority is 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW; extension authorities point to the same EOA where checked.

controls.evidence: At Solana slot 425799131: USDK mintAuthority=C9eLDmptrnMxFb5QB3J4QuRFYjZFba7393ncm9cM7ot7. Ed25519 curve check confirms this address is off-curve (not a keypair) — it is a PDA derived from M0 extension program extaykYu5AQcDm3qZAbiDN3yp6skqn6Nssj7veUUGZw with seeds=["mint_authority"], nonce=255. PDA derivation verified computationally. The extension program upgrade authority is 9QpF8a9TDM9DMiQ556bjEAyAx3WRunzW9HfiDcAPNyJW (funded EOA, System program owner), shared across all M0 Solana programs. USDK freeze authority (7Ahg145ZRP5LASPjAphRcHoR1UgvLjbZR5MP1j3dPpFr) is also a null/uninitialized account (off-curve PDA). Extension authorities (metadataPointer, confidentialTransfer, transferHook) = 9QpF8a9T... (same EOA).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable non-proxy. At Solana slot 425799131: USDK mintAuthority C9eLDmptrnMxFb5QB3J4QuRFYjZFba7393ncm9cM7ot7 confirmed off-curve PDA of extaykYu5AQcDm3qZAbiDN3yp6skqn6Nssj7veUUGZw (seeds=["mint_authority"], nonce=255); extension program upgrade authority=9QpF8a9T... (shared EOA across all M0 Solana programs). Null uninitialized account is expected for PDAs; off-curve check proves it cannot be a free keypair. Upgradeability: USDK is an SPL Token-2022 mint on Solana (mint account usdkbee86pkLyRmxfFCdkyySpxRb5ndCxVsK2BkRXwX). SPL mint state is not a deployable proxy: the mint logic is fixed by the Token-2022 program (non-upgradeable), and the mint authority is the M0 Portal PDA (off-curve, seeds ["mint_authority"]) verified at slot 425799131 — there is no upgrade authority that can change mint logic.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDK is a Solana M extension, not native unbridged issuance. Its mint-authority PDA wraps Portal-delivered M in an extension vault; M0 documents that Solana M is minted by the M0 Portal against M locked in the Ethereum HubPortal through Wormhole NTT.

routes.protocol: M0 Solana Portal / Wormhole NTT / M extension
routes.reviewNote: Composite route: Wormhole NTT carries M from the Ethereum HubPortal to the Solana Portal, then the USDK extension locks Solana M and mints the exact USDK token through its mint-authority PDA.
